finding_a: Charter leads on residential locations in 19 states vs Comcast in 27 (5 neither); the location margin is +5.54M units in New York and -4.36M in Pennsylvania, and by Census division Charter’s only positive unit-margin clusters are East North Central (-0.41M, 2 lead states) and West South Central (+3.55M, Texas-driven) while South Atlantic is -3.57M and Middle Atlantic -1.12M.
finding_b: ACS usual-WFH ranges from 22.9% in District of Columbia to 6.2% in Mississippi; worker-weighted, Mountain is highest among the 9 divisions at 15.4% vs East South Central at 9.9% (US 13.3%; 51-state+DC worker-weighted 13.3%).
finding_c: Florida has the highest 500+ firm employment share at 60.4%; Montana is lowest at 33.7%; employment-weighted, South Atlantic is the most large-firm-dense division at 57.0% vs Pacific at 51.8% (US / 51-state+DC 54.1%).
